symptom: On OIDC SSO 2.3.2's OIDC.Snip_Configuration, `alter snippet … set (Caption: 'Edit X') on actionButton4` (a legacy grid control-bar button) failed with 'widget "actionButton4" not found'; describe listed the grid's columns but no buttons, though its comment said buttons were addressable; show widgets omitted them.
file: mdl/backend/pagemutator/legacygrid.go controlBarItemKeys (finder, nearest-DS, scope walks in mutator.go); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_legacy_grid.go storedItems (+ caption from CaptionTemplate, action); mdl/catalog/builder_pages.go walkWidget. Tests: *_2382_test.go in pagemutator, executor, catalog
cause: Forms$GridControlBar.Items and Forms$SearchBar.Items are STORED as `NewButtons` (modelsdk/gen/keyaudit_test.go lists both); every walk read `Items`. #1459's search-field addressing was tested on a synthetic grid built with `Items`, so it never worked on a real project either.
insight: **Build a legacy-shape test fixture from a dumped real unit, not from the metamodel names.** `mxcli bson dump -t snippet -o OIDC.Snip_Configuration` showed ControlBar and SearchBar both holding `NewButtons`; the key audit already listed the mismatch but nothing consulted it when #1459 added the walk. Measured on the real snippet: set Caption and set Action on actionButton4 written; describe lists 6 buttons with caption and action; show widgets lists them (after a catalog rebuild — the catalog cache carries no builder version, so an old cache keeps the old index).
